{{Top}}
The '''Multi-Frequency Targeting and Acquisition System''', also known as '''MFTAS''', was a sensor system used in helmets that provided assistance in acquiring targets in conditions of poor visibility and at long ranges.

A vision augmenter, the system allowed the user to see through darkness, smoke, rain, and through other poor visibility hazards. This system was extensively used in [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|Stormtrooper armor]], as well as in multiple other armors such as the [[DZ 17X Nemesis]], [[NLZ5-11 Dragon]], the [[Juggernaut 510 Combat Power Armor]], and even personal armors such as [[Cragus 12's bounty hunter armor]].
